items.name: Open
items.doc: Open decrypts and verifies the output of Seal; a bad tag is an error.
items.summary: Open decrypts and verifies the output of Seal; a bad tag is an error.

items.name: Seal
items.doc: Seal encrypts and authenticates with ChaCha20-Poly1305 (RFC 8439; 32-byte key, 12-byte nonce); the result is the ciphertext followed by the tag.
items.summary: Seal encrypts and authenticates with ChaCha20-Poly1305 (RFC 8439; 32-byte key, 12-byte nonce); the result is the ciphertext followed by the tag.
